description: This file defines a TypeScript class 'CloseComCRMService' implementing CRM interface, handling integration with Close.com for calendar events, contacts, and custom activities. It includes credential parsing, authentication, and CRUD operations for events and contacts, along with utility functions and a factory export.

classes.name: CloseComCRMService
classes.description: A class implementing CRM interface for Close.com integration, managing authentication, event, and contact operations.

methods.name: closeComUpdateCustomActivity
methods.description: Updates a custom activity in Close.com with given UID and calendar event data.

methods.name: closeComDeleteCustomActivity
methods.description: Deletes a custom activity in Close.com by UID.

methods.name: createEvent
methods.description: Creates a new calendar event as a custom activity in Close.com.

methods.name: updateEvent
methods.description: Updates an existing event in Close.com.

methods.name: deleteEvent
methods.description: Deletes an event in Close.com by UID.

methods.name: getContacts
methods.description: Retrieves contacts from Close.com matching given emails.

methods.name: createContacts
methods.description: Creates contacts in Close.com, attaching them to a lead.
